Project House: desktop design

One layout, built from the ui-ux-pro-max design system for our product type, in the two colour palettes it generated. Desktop first, at 1280 px; the phone layout is designed last. Interface text is in Uzbek, the default language.

Style (ui-ux-pro-max)Minimalism and Swiss style, flat. The four closest product types in its database (portfolio, job board, developer community, CV builder) all point here.
FontInter, one family. Of 15 fonts checked in their files, only Inter, IBM Plex Sans, Nunito Sans and Onest have Russian plus the Uzbek oʻ and ʼ. Poppins, Outfit, Archivo, Space Grotesk and Plus Jakarta Sans have no Russian.
Layout (our research)Demo on the left; on the right the problem, result, tech, role, licence and the author with Message, all on the first screen. No competitor shows these together.

Content: the project page uses NVIDIA's public Instant NGP repo; the feed uses 8 projects from our temporary demo data, described in our own words. Images are drawn placeholders. The role, the "open to work" badge and the like counts are made-up examples. Contrast: every text colour pair used here is at least 4.5:1 (WCAG); palette 2's sky blue and green are used only where they pass.
